author: Mao Gomez
text:
Make sure you have no plans to update your phone anytime quicker because Libre never catches up with technology any fast… useless when you have new phones.

My experience with disconnections and misreadings, and lack of alarms was appalling.

Their customer service was even worse, rude and patronising, and never solved anything.

Since I moved to Dexcom, never looked back.

author: Jenny Velasquez
text: Yup Libre 3 +  I can afford, while Dexcom I cannot
